# Prospect Magazine

> A leading British magazine of ideas, politics, and culture offering in-depth analysis of democracy, economics, media, and contemporary affairs.

Prospect Magazine is a prestigious publication covering UK politics, economics, culture, and ideas with a focus on investigative journalism and critical analysis. The site features expert commentary on government, Brexit, Scottish independence, financial markets, and cultural criticism alongside coverage of major events like the Hay Festival.

## Key Topics

- UK Politics
- Democracy
- Brexit
- Scottish Independence
- Political Commentary
- Economics
- Media Criticism
- Financial Crisis
- Journalism Ethics
- Literary Criticism
- Reform UK
- SNP
- Government Policy
- Trade & Economics
- Civil Liberties

## Politics & Democracy

- [Democracy](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/politics/democracy): Democracy and political analysis covering elections and accountability
- [Government](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/politics/democracy/government): Latest government news and political analysis from Prospect Magazine
- [Scottish Independence & Indyref](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/politics/scotland/scottish-independence/indyref): Scottish independence referendum coverage and SNP politics analysis
- [Deputy Prime Minister](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/politics/parliament/deputy-prime-minister): Deputy Prime Minister political analysis and commentary from Prospect
- [Protests News](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/politics/protests-news): Protest coverage, civil liberties, and activism news from Prospect

## Economics & Business

- [Financial Crash](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/business/financial-crash): 2008 financial crisis analysis and banking regulation commentary
- [Trade](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/economics/trade): Trade deals, Brexit, and international economics analysis
- [Borrowing](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/economics/borrowing): Government debt and fiscal policy analysis from Prospect Magazine
- [Oil](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/business/industry-news/oil): Oil industry, energy policy, and climate change coverage

## Media & Journalism

- [Newspapers and Magazines](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/media/newspapers-and-magazines): Media criticism covering journalism ethics and press freedom
- [The Spy Papers](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/media/phone-hacking/the-spy-papers): Phone hacking scandal investigation and British media corruption coverage
- [The Economist](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/media/newspapers-and-magazines/economist): Media criticism and analysis of The Economist magazine coverage
- [Financial Times](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/media/newspapers-and-magazines/financial-times): Financial Times journalism and economics analysis from Prospect
- [Wendell Steavenson](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/journalism/wendell-steavenson): Journalist Wendell Steavenson profile and political essays

## Culture & Books

- [Biography](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/culture/books/biography): Biography book reviews and literary criticism from Prospect Magazine
- [George Orwell](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/culture/books/novelists/george-orwell): George Orwell literary criticism and political thought analysis
- [Hay Festival](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/culture/books/hay-festival): Hay Festival coverage with author interviews and book recommendations
- [Pop Music](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/culture/music/pop): Pop music criticism and contemporary artist analysis from Prospect

## Science & Ideas

- [Biology](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/ideas/technology/biology): Biology and scientific discovery articles from Prospect Magazine

## Contributors & Columnists

- [Stephen Collins](https://www.prospectmagazine.co.uk/views/columns/stephen-collins): Editorial cartoonist Stephen Collins profile and political satire
